payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses a 2D DP array dp[26][n] where dp[c][j] accumulates counts of matching subsequences from t that form a substring of s ending at position j with character c. Iterates over t, updating dp based on previous character matches in s.
payload.rationale: The DP state is explicitly two-dimensional (character and position in s), matching the dp_2d_state pattern. The outer loop over t updates this 2D table using recurrence on adjacent positions.
